description: Evaluation suite verifying right-sized ideation-to-MVP with 'I don't know' fallback, flat micro-CLI sizing without empty layers, repository organization with Triad v2.1/README/contract sync, and near-miss boundaries.

evals.prompt: I want to build a system to organize my study notes and spaced-repetition reviews, but I don't know which exact features to include yet.
evals.expected_output: Enters Mode 1 (ideation_to_v1), investigates core objective, activates the 'I don't know' fallback proposing 1 runnable minimal vertical-slice MVP feature set, defers extras, and offers dated v1.0.0 confirmation.
assertions: Triggers intelligent 'I don't know' fallback proposing a single runnable vertical slice
Proposes right-sized layout without speculative empty folders and asks for v1.0.0 confirmation

evals.prompt: Organize my existing repository end-to-end: align Triad v2.1 docs (AGENTS.md and .context/), clean stray root scripts safely, align active FastMCP tools and FastAPI schemas, and sync README.md 1:1 with disk.
evals.expected_output: Enters Mode 2 (project_organizer_sync), aligns root AGENTS.md + .context/{spec,context}.md (Triad v2.1) and README.md 1:1 with disk while preserving working imports, structures active MCP/FastAPI contracts, checks .env/.gitignore + git remote, and previews root moves via Dry-Run.
assertions: Enforces 1:1 README.md vs. disk parity and Triad v2.1 alignment via bootstrap-project.ps1
Organizes only active MCP and FastAPI strict schemas without inventing unused RPC layers
Requires Dry-Run preview before moving/deleting root files

evals.prompt: Organize this messy folder containing loose files test1.py, run_old.py, and scratch_notes.txt.
evals.expected_output: Detects ambiguous project intent, asks 1-3 focused clarification questions before restructuring, and presents a Dry-Run relocation preview without deleting files unilaterally.
assertions: Detects ambiguous repository purpose and asks <= 3 clarifying questions
Presents Dry-Run relocation preview prior to modifying root files

evals.prompt: Convert this finished Markdown file meeting_minutes.md into an A4 formatted PDF using headless Microsoft Edge.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger project-idea-organizer; delegates Markdown/HTML-to-PDF rendering to html-pdf-converter.
assertions: Routes standalone PDF conversion to html-pdf-converter

evals.prompt: Run a 0-100 AST code audit, dead-code scan, and live browser @eX 3-layer navigation check on our repository.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT trigger project-idea-organizer; delegates 0-100 AST and live DOM auditing to system-project-auditor.
assertions: Abstains from project restructuring when a 0-100 audit is requested
Routes AST + live @eX navigation scoring to system-project-auditor

evals.prompt: Turn my raw idea for a local CSV-to-JSON invoice deduplicator CLI into a v1.0.0 MVP.
evals.expected_output: Selects Micro/CLI scale (1-4 files), proposes a flat vertical-slice layout (dedup.py, tests/test_dedup.py, pyproject.toml, .gitignore, README.md) and explicitly forbids creating src/api/, src/domain/, src/contracts/, DESIGN.md, or tools.json.
assertions: Selects flat Micro/CLI layout (1-4 files) rather than multi-layer src/api/domain/contracts
Omits unused MCP tools.json, FastAPI, RPC, and UI DESIGN.md artifacts
